svg.title: A genuine OTP can still be relayed
svg.desc: Synthetic scenario: the code is real, but the person requesting it may be an impostor. Platform rules differ. Attacker starts a request: Attempts login or account recovery; the platform still requires its other conditions. Real platform sends the OTP: The platform sends a code for that operation to Lin's phone. Lin receives a real code and a fake call: A genuine OTP arrives while an impostor claiming to be support asks Lin to read it out. Lin discloses the code to the impostor: The account holder relays the code to the attacker instead of using a trusted entry point. Attacker attempts to submit the code: The code is sent to the real platform. Success depends on other conditions and the actual records.
